scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:client: node init && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.dev:server: node init && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.build: node init && npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
